home.title: Boxes
home.desc: See the contents and odds first, then verify each result on the spot.

box.desc: This box holds {n} items, and each tier shows its odds.
box.confirmDesc: {amount} will be paid from your balance.
box.openFail: The box did not open. Your balance is unchanged.

reveal.itemDesc: It is in your inventory, and you can choose how to receive it now.
reveal.cashDesc: USDT items go to your balance as soon as you open.
reveal.multiDesc: Your items are in your inventory.
reveal.takenDesc: You took USDT instead of the item.
reveal.takeDesc: You receive {amount} instead of {name}, and this cannot be undone.
reveal.rowHint: Select a row to verify that result.
reveal.shippedDesc: Shipping is requested, and you can follow it in your inventory.

login.title: Log in
login.codeDesc: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email.
login.terms: By continuing, you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy.
login.recoverDesc: A verification code is sent to your email.

charge.title: Add USDT
charge.desc: Send USDT to the address below and it is added to your balance.
charge.loginDesc: Log in to see your deposit address.
charge.addressFail: The address could not be loaded. Choose the network again.

verify.title: Verify result
verify.desc: The number is recalculated in this browser from the value locked before opening.
verify.ok: The recalculated result matches the item you received.
verify.bad: The recalculated result does not match the item you received.
verify.failed: The result could not be calculated. The record has empty values.

inv.title: Inventory
inv.desc: Select an item to ship it or take USDT.

empty.shipping: You have no items in shipping.

inv.loginLine: Log in to see your items.
inv.waitingTracking: The tracking number appears once the item ships.
inv.cancelDesc: The item returns to your inventory, and the shipping fee returns to your balance.
inv.cancelFailed: The request could not be cancelled. The item may have shipped already.

ship.title: Ship it
ship.desc: Enter the delivery address, and the item ships after inspection.
ship.errRecipient: Enter a recipient name of two or more characters.
ship.errPhone: Enter the phone number in digits.
ship.errAddress: Enter the full address including the unit.
ship.errPccc: The personal customs code is P followed by 12 digits.
ship.confirmDesc: The item ships to {address}, and the request cannot be cancelled after dispatch.
ship.failed: The shipping request was not accepted. The item is still in your inventory.
